system.description:
Prerequisites: Advanced Dementation, Intermediate Dominate (Conditioning). This Malkavian combination Discipline "folds" a latent Derangement into a target's psyche, lying dormant and unnoticed until a chosen trigger event causes it to erupt in full force for the remainder of the scene or one hour, whichever is longer; the victim cannot spend Willpower to suppress it during that time, though she may still act and defend herself. The user selects a Derangement and makes a Social Test against the target, retested with Empathy, at two Traits down if the user does not personally suffer that Derangement. If the target has three or fewer permanent Willpower Traits, the user may spend a Willpower Trait to make the triggered Derangement permanent (requiring therapy to buy off later). As a Dominate-based power it only affects mortals or Kindred of equal or higher generation, and a victim cannot be targeted again until the current effect resolves.

Costs 12 Experience Traits to learn.
system.duration: Dormant until triggered; active for one scene or one hour
